context: Kenji and Ren coordinate a site project.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: workplace coordination; vocabulary (部門/本部/指示/工事/資格) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 工事の段取りは、決まりましたか?
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm focused throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本部から、指示が届きましたよ。
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どの部門が、担当ですか?
lines.style: curious young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 技術部門が、工事を担当します。
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 特別な資格が、要るんですか?
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、資格を持つ人だけが入れます。
lines.en: Yes, only qualified people can enter.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本部の指示を、各部門に共有しますね。
lines.en: I'll share HQ's instructions with each department.
lines.style: reliable young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 資格の確認も、忘れずにね。
lines.en: Don't forget to verify qualifications too.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
